card.name: Digits inside citation and count numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits or the space before a number in the middle of multi-digit figures. Mostly in reference lists (volume, page, ISBN, court reporter) and in patient counts.

modes.label: Citation numbers
modes.description: A digit within a volume, page, or ISBN number in a reference.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space just before a number in a legal cite or percentage list.
modes.example: t. v. Tyson Fresh Meats, Inc., 315 F. Supp. 2d<< >>1172 (M.D.

modes.label: Patient counts
modes.description: A middle digit of a group size in trial results.
modes.example: among the 7<<1>>7 patients in the lower hemoglobin group

card.writes: No clear meaning from the promoted tokens, which are mixed and mostly non-English; it seems to shape how the next digits are predicted.
card.plain: It fires on a digit partway through a long number in a reference or a patient count.
